item.tib: srid rgyal gsang bskang zlog gzhung gis glud kyi mdel kha
item.coloph: srid rgyal gsang bskang bzlog (skong zlog) mdos kyis(kyi) / glud mdos mdel kha bstan pa'o/ dgongs ldan gshen gyi spyod yul yin/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan bzhin du/ nges med rnal 'byor tshul 'dzin gyis/ yi ge ris su bris pa la/ nyes 'gal byung na ye shes lha/ mkha' 'gro srung ma'i spyan sngar bshags/ dge des rang gzhan don 'grub par/ mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur ('gyur) cig sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
